syllabus_decision.title: Food Technology 7–10 Syllabus (2019)
syllabus_decision.implementation_basis: 2019 current for 2026; local early use of 2025 not evidenced

period_allocation.basis: Twenty planning sequence slots; not approved periods or hours

source_register.title: Official 2019 syllabus DOCX, Stage 5 outcome statements
Section video candidates and non-video pathways
source_register.status: No accepted video claim; use the equivalent non-video path

outcome_coverage.statement: demonstrates hygienic handling of food to ensure a safe and appealing product
identifies, assesses and manages the risks of injury and WHS issues associated with the handling of food
describes the physical and chemical properties of a variety of foods
accounts for changes to the properties of food which occur during food processing, preparation and storage
applies appropriate methods of food processing, preparation and storage
describes the relationship between food consumption, the nutritional value of foods and the health of individuals and communities
justifies food choices by analysing the factors that influence eating habits
collects, evaluates and applies information from a variety of sources
communicates ideas and information using a range of media and appropriate terminology
selects and employs appropriate techniques and equipment for a variety of food-specific purposes
plans, prepares, presents and evaluates food solutions for specific purposes
examines the relationship between food, technology and society
evaluates the impact of activities related to food on the individual, society and the environment

website_learning_inventory.title: Local produce, waste and value adding

planning_sequence.teaching: Compare food availability with real access using two households and a stocked shop. Read, sort availability/access evidence, then explain a barrier without blaming people.
planning_sequence.syllabus_content: Food equity: investigate access to suitable food and factors shaping food choices.
planning_sequence.planned_evidence: The 10-question check and one written access comparison saved locally.

official_content_refs.match: causes of food inequity and influences on availability

planning_sequence.teaching: Trace food and safe-water supply barriers; weigh what desalination can and cannot address. Use the systems visual to mark an interruption and test response trade-offs.
planning_sequence.syllabus_content: Food equity: examine barriers to food and water supply and possible responses.
planning_sequence.planned_evidence: The 10-question check and one comparison of responses saved locally.

official_content_refs.match: food security, water and distribution barriers

planning_sequence.teaching: Test a food-access claim against dated, local evidence and design a targeted response. Separate observation from inference; write a claim-evidence-limitation conclusion.
planning_sequence.syllabus_content: Food equity: investigate food inequity using evidence and evaluate strategies for change.
planning_sequence.planned_evidence: The 10-question check and one evaluated access plan saved locally.

official_content_refs.match: groups at risk and the role of local or global aid

planning_sequence.planned_focus: Apply and select evidence - Food Equity
planning_sequence.teaching: Use the Module 1 applied scenario and puzzle bank. Review all three checks; select one meaningful folio record.
planning_sequence.syllabus_content: Food equity: apply and communicate a reasoned food decision using relevant evidence.
planning_sequence.planned_evidence: Formative activity choice/justification and one selected folio card; formal submission remains in Classroom.

planning_sequence.teaching: Reserved planning slot only. Enter the approved recipe/brief, equipment, supervision, risk controls, preparation and clean-down before use. Allocate actual time from the local timetable.
planning_sequence.syllabus_content: Food equity: practical food design, preparation and evaluation under current school procedures.

planning_sequence.teaching: Identify drivers of a food trend and distinguish popularity from evidence of benefit. Sort fictional trend headlines into description, claim and evidence.

planning_sequence.teaching: Read a label fairly and evaluate a trend claim for a named consumer. Compare fictional labels per 100 g and name an unanswered question.
